neighbours.label: the word-initial ' tr' or ' ch' piece of a word the tokenizer splits (tr|ams, ch|utes, ch|asm, ch|ancel), strongest for transport and conveyance words; whole-token words in the same slot stay quiet
fire: Visitors can ride the old trams along the seafront in summer.
Coal slid down the steel chutes into the waiting wagons.
A narrow chasm opened between the two cliffs after the quake.
The choir gathered in the chancel before the evening service.
Fishermen unloaded the trawler at dawn on the quay.
The bishop raised the silver chalice during the mass.
Passengers boarded Island Line Trains at the pier station.
The carpenter sharpened his chisel before carving the door.
quiet: Visitors can ride the old buses along the seafront in summer.
Coal slid down the steel ramps into the waiting wagons.
A narrow gap opened between the two cliffs after the quake.
The choir gathered in the church before the evening service.
Fishermen unloaded the boat at dawn on the quay.
The bishop raised the silver cup during the mass.
Passengers boarded the ferry at the pier station.
The carpenter sharpened his knife before carving the door.
